messages:
casey (AE): POC ask from VeridianHealth: they want to run a 14-day Dedicated trial but the deal hinges on SSO (SAML), SCIM for 40k users (Okta source), RBAC mapping (fine-grained roles), and automated domain ownership verification. They also sent the security questionnaire. Can we cover all these before kickoff Fri?

rui (Solutions Eng): We can. Immediate needs: IdP metadata (SAML XML), Okta SCIM connector config (they usually export a SCIM token and base URL), and an RBAC CSV mapping (group_name -> role_id). Also confirm whether they require delta-only syncs or full re-provisioning on first run.

nora (SE): For the Dedicated trial pricing: recommended template is 2xA10G GPUs, 14 days, capped egress and token usage. I suggest we offer an "evaluation" price line item (no long-term commit) and a one-time import/enablement fee for the Okta bulk import. Finance sign-off needed.

vikram (Security): On the questionnaire: we can provide SOC2 Type II report and our dataflow diagram. We need to flag that for Dedicated trials in EU we provision in eu-west region only and that keys remain in Redwood KMS unless they request customer-managed KMS (requires contract addendum). Also confirm whether any PHI will be transmitted; that materially changes scope.

ellie (Sales Ops): Legal asked about domain ownership proof methods and admin delegation. We support DNS TXT verification, SAML metadata verification, and an API-based verification webhook for automated flows. Admin delegation: we can create delegated org admins scoped to specific domains; need to list allowed actions for legal.

casey (AE): Veridian says Okta export will be their source of truth and they want a one-time bulk import (~40k) + delta sync after that. They asked whether we support Okta's CSV bulk or the SCIM Bulk endpoint.

rui (Solutions Eng): We prefer SCIM Bulk for automation. Our bulk import recommendations:
```
POST /scim/v2/Bulk
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <token>
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:Bulk"],
  "Operations": [ ... ]
}
```
Constraints: chunk <= 2,500 users per request, async job for >5k (we spin an import job), default rate limit: 600 calls/min per org. Retry pattern: on 429, respect Retry-After header; exponential backoff starting at 5s. For CSV-based imports we run an async import job (upload to staging S3 bucket) — needs 48h lead.

nora (SE): Okta connector: if they want to point their Okta SCIM app to our SCIM base URL, we can provide an org-scoped token for the connector. For SAML, we support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows; we need their metadata file and ACS URL.

vikram (Security): Additional security notes for presales pack: show minimal permissions for the SCIM token (provision:Users, update:Users, group:read), rotateable tokens, and audit log exports. For EU residency we include a data processing addendum excerpt. If they require HSM-backed keys, escalate to contracts.

casey (AE): Action list: @rui put together a 1-page SAML + Okta SCIM runbook and sample RBAC CSV; @vikram assemble the security answers + SOC2 snippet; @nora draft the Dedicated trial quote with optional enablement fee for bulk import; @ellie coordinate legal wording for delegated admins. I'll batch-send the presales pack to Veridian by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Created event "VeridianHealth POC - presales kickoff" — 2025-08-02 15:00 UTC. Invitees: casey (AE), rui (Solutions Eng), nora (SE), vikram (Security), ellie (Sales Ops). Link: https://cal.example/evt/VER-PROOF

rui (Solutions Eng): Quick RBAC example to include in runbook:
```
# CSV columns: group_name, role_name, allowed_permissions
engineering-admins,app_admin,[create,delete,assign_roles]
support-team,support_agent,[view_logs,run_health_checks]
```

nora (SE): Note for finance: enablement fee usually covers staging import (+24-48h) and one support engineer for the bulk run. If they want repeated bulk snapshots we charge per snapshot.

vikram (Security): Legal edge: delegated admins can perform user invitations and role assignment but cannot access raw token material or KMS controls. Document that explicitly.

casey (AE): Perfect. If Okta bulk or EU residency is a blocker we'll need to escalate to contracts. Otherwise pack ready. I'll send a checklist to Veridian and request IdP metadata + Okta SCIM token export by EOD today. :pray:
